game_concept: A speed quiz set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing, a cracking glacier: the sherpa guide must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Vowel Counter: Count vowels in words by looping over characters.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing: a cracking glacier
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Crossing, repeat each round: Count vowels in words by looping over characters. Each round, a new supply crates challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the vowels value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 150 points of supply crates by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 150, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 4 (applied tier): Vowel Counter
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Vowel Counter' (Week 8 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Glacier Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

code_snippet:
for ch in word:
    if ch in 'aeiou':
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vowels changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Glacier Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 150 within 55 seconds.
